opening_message:
Ticket 1: Maurice Perez (employee ID E036) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E036.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Maurice Perez (E036) is a full_time Engineer. Requested write access to Source Code. As a full_time employee, up to write is allowed (admin would require role ownership). Grant requested level: write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E036 is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors can have read, or write only with advanced training (never admin). Requested write exceeds maximum; grant maximum: read.
reason: HR note (ticket 1) identifies E036 as a full_time Engineer. Engineers own Source Code, so a full-time employee's maximum is admin; the requested write is at or below the maximum, so grant write. (Note: the security note lists E036 as a contractor with basic training, which conflicts on employment type; I am relying on HR as authoritative for employment type and role.)
